main_body: T-shaped wooden timber prop consisting of a wide horizontal top crossbeam supported by a central vertical post
top_band: light ochre-tan horizontal top face of the crossbeam with wood grain dots (rows 10-12) bounded by a dark brown back edge (row 9) and a bright cream front-edge highlight line (row 13)
evidence: Reading down column 7: row 9 is the dark brown back edge, rows 10-12 form a 3-row light tan horizontal top surface, and row 13 is a 1-row bright cream front-edge highlight (4 top rows total). Below that, rows 14-17 form the 4-row vertical front face of the crossbeam with a dark bottom overhang at row 17, and rows 18-47 form the recessed vertical post shaded beneath the beam.

style.evidence: The wood ramp uses 6 distinct warm brown/ochre steps from the cream edge highlight down to the deep brown shadow tone. Outlines use dark brown material tones selectively (with open value-separated side edges on the crossbeam), and both the beam and narrow vertical post carry wood grain, knots, peg highlights, and a soft cast shadow matching the Beodeul reference props.
